note: Same computer, headless Chrome, one student joined to a real class. Every check runs with the panel it measures visible: a hidden panel has an empty box and would pass against broken code. Play Solo is NOT covered here - a Solo game runs from its first tick, so `wagonProjection` sends nothing and a Solo player never sees the wagon panel or the stock choice at all. No LAN or district claim.

observed.titleCard: YOUR STORY BEGINS HERE Who will your family be? Autumn 1835. Your wagon has reached Texas. The people who step off it—and what they bring—are about to become your story. 01 Roll your household 02 Give it a surname 03 Name each person 04 Choose the parents' looks The first time something new happens, a short tip says what to do and what it costs. Make my family →
observed.diePanel: STEP 1 OF 4 · THE BEGINNING Roll for your family The die decides how many are in your family and who they are. It is thrown once. There is no second roll, so the family it gives you is the family you play. 01 · YOUR FAMILY 20 The people who travel with you 02 · WHAT YOU BRING 20 A second die, thrown with it, decides what the family has to start with: a cart, wagons or nothing to haul with, the oxen, and a few reales. One throw. A whole life ahead. Roll the die
observed.meansResult: Hard up. No wagon or cart: an ox to carry the packs, the family's horse, and 3 reales. 1 rides the horse and 6 walk.
observed.surnamePanel: STEP 2 OF 4 Name your family Family Last Name Everybody in the family carries it. It is chosen once and cannot be changed afterwards; first names can be changed at any time, on the family panel. YOUR FAMILY: Benjamin, Mary, Noah, Harriet, Peter, Effie, Louisa Name the family
observed.surnamePeople: Benjamin, Mary, Noah, Harriet, Peter, Effie, Louisa
observed.surnamePreview: Benjamin Halloran, Mary Halloran, Noah Halloran, Harriet Halloran, Peter Halloran, Effie Halloran, Louisa Halloran
observed.namesHint: Step 3 of 4. They are already named: change any you like, or press Continue and keep them. You can rename anybody later on the family panel.
observed.looksStep: Step 4 of 4. Parent 1 of 2. Save this look, then choose the next parent.
observed.looksNote: Children are not asked for: they inherit your family's colors and grow into their own age-appropriate figures. Chosen once, a look stays with them. Appearance changes nothing in the game.
observed.looksStep1: Step 4 of 4. Parent 1 of 2. Save this look, then choose the next parent.
observed.looksStep2: Step 4 of 4. Parent 2 of 2. Save when ready to meet your family.
observed.keyFor: This key brings you back to your family on any Chromebook. If this one forgets you, or you sit at another, choose “I already have a family key” and type it in.
observed.wagonText: What you load is what the family arrives with. Tools, seed and powder can be bought in a town later, if there is coin; the things for the house cannot be bought anywhere.
observed.wagonWhen: You can change all of this until your teacher presses Start. After that the ox's packs are packed.
observed.stockNo: No stock. The family holds a labor of land, 177 acres, and brings no animals.
observed.stockYes: Drive cattle and hogs in. The family holds a league and a labor, 4,606 acres - about 26 times as much land - and the herd's keep takes 2 spaces of the ox's packs. The family arrives with 6 cattle and 12 hogs, which feed themselves on the range and feed the family.

startCards.anglo: A SETTLER FAMILY - Autumn 1835. Your family has come from the United States to land of its own near Mina, in Austin's colony. Texas is part of Mexico, and most of its new settlers, like you, came from the United States.
startCards.tejano: A TEJANO FAMILY - Autumn 1835. Your family is Tejano: Mexican Texans. You are taking up land of your own near Victoria, in De León's colony, the one colony in Texas settled mostly by Mexican families. Its people farm and raise horses and cattle.
startCards.free-black: A FREE BLACK FAMILY - Autumn 1835. Your family is free and Black. You have come west from Louisiana to land of your own near Liberty, in the Galveston Bay and Texas Land Company grant, as the Ashworths did a few years before you. Under Mexico's laws a free Black family may own land like any other. Not every neighbour is glad you came.
startCards.bexar: A TEJANO FAMILY OF BÉXAR - Autumn 1835. Your family is Tejano: Mexican Texans. You are taking up a rancho on the San Antonio River near Béxar, the oldest town in Texas, where families raise cattle, horses and corn. A Mexican garrison holds the town, and your neighbours do not all take the same side.
